title: Stage 22 advisory. Muddy, slippery section before the tea gardens.
impact: The trail is generally in good condition. Expect muddy, slippery surfaces after afternoon rain, and growing vegetation before the tea garden area between Courtlodge Tea Garden and Pedro Estate.
action: Hike with caution in suitable weather.

title: Stage 21 advisory. Overgrowth near the vegetable farming area.
impact: The trail is generally in good condition. Afternoon rain is making surfaces muddy and slippery, and vegetation may narrow some sections. The vegetable farming area is challenging due to overgrowth.
action: Hike with caution in suitable weather, especially during the rainy season.

title: Stage 17 advisory. Overgrowth and leeches towards Hali Ela.
impact: The trail is generally in good condition. Overgrowth and leeches are reported in the final section towards Hali Ela. Afternoon rain and low visibility can make navigation hard, especially in overgrown areas.
action: Hike with caution during the rainy season.

title: Stage 16 advisory. Overgrowth on the road to Demodara railway.
impact: The trail is generally in good condition. Afternoon rain is making surfaces muddy and slippery, and vegetation may narrow some sections. Rapid overgrowth is reported on the road leading to Demodara railway, and maintenance is required there.
action: Hike with caution in suitable weather.

title: Yellow advisory. Muddy and slippery after rain.
impact: Stage is generally in good condition. Expect muddy, slippery surfaces after afternoon rain, and growing vegetation.
action: Hike with caution in suitable weather.

title: Stage 13 advisory. Overgrowth and leeches after Haputale.
impact: The trail is in good condition, with some uneven surfaces. The forest section after Haputale is overgrown with many leeches, and there is some overgrowth midway. Visibility can be low in rain and early mornings. Mobile reception may be weak.
action: Recommended for hiking. Take care in low visibility, and be prepared for leeches.

title: Stage 11 advisory. Uneven surfaces and no mobile reception.
impact: From Horton Plains, the stage mainly follows a tarred road to the Devil's Staircase viewpoint. Conditions are good, but uneven surfaces make some sections challenging. There is no mobile reception, and visibility drops in rain.
action: Hike with caution in the rainy season. Tell someone your plans before you start, as there is no mobile reception.

title: Stage 10 advisory. Slippery sections after rain.
impact: The trail is generally in good condition, but renewed rain is making some sections slippery. Vegetation is growing onto the path in places.
action: Hike with caution in suitable weather.

title: Stage 8 advisory. Muddy, overgrown section near the fuel station.
impact: The trail is generally in good condition, with afternoon rain. An overgrown section near the fuel station (petrol pumps) is muddy and slippery.
action: Hike with caution, especially in muddy sections.

title: Stage 6 advisory. Short overgrown section near km 3.
impact: The stage remains in good condition. After the first 3 km, before the railway line, rain has bent vegetation into the path, making a section of under 50 meters hard to navigate. A few muddy spots are reported.
action: Hike with caution during the rainy season, and watch your footing on the short overgrown section.

title: Stage 5 advisory. Overgrown section before the power plant.
impact: The trail is in good condition. Rain has fallen several times in the last week. An overgrown section is reported before the power plant area.
action: Recommended for hiking. Take care through the overgrown section.

title: Stage 1 advisory. Overgrowth near the viewpoint and forest section.
impact: The trail is in good condition. Rapid overgrowth is reported near the viewpoint and close to the fine forest section, and maintenance is required there. Rain has fallen through the last week, mainly as afternoon showers.
action: Recommended for hiking. Start early to avoid afternoon showers, and take care in the overgrown sections.

title: Stage 20 precaution. Landslide risk and low visibility in continuous rain.
impact: Rain is falling throughout the day, raising the risk of landslides. Low visibility, difficult navigation, overgrown sections and possible wild animal encounters make hiking risky at present. The vegetable farming area is challenging due to overgrowth.
action: Hike only in suitable weather, and with caution.

title: Stage 19 precaution. Muddy, slippery and overgrown sections.
impact: Afternoon rain is making surfaces muddy and slippery, and vegetation is narrowing some sections. Overgrowth is reported near the Suspension Bridge and after the hospital.
action: Hike with caution, and only in suitable weather.

title: Stage 18 precaution. Overgrowth and leeches towards Etampitiya.
impact: Overgrowth and leeches are reported in the final section towards Etampitiya. Afternoon rain and low visibility can make navigation challenging, especially in overgrown areas.
action: Hike with caution during the rainy season. Start early to avoid afternoon rain where possible.

title: Stage 12 precaution. Overgrowth, loose soil and leeches. Not advised on rainy days.
impact: Rapid overgrowth is reported near the abandoned village, after the fine forest section, towards the railway station, and on the final section after the bird sanctuary. Loose soil is reported along the trail, especially when wet. Leech activity is high between the main village and the abandoned village.
action: Avoid this stage on rainy days. Hike with caution on loose soil and slippery sections.

title: Stage 9 precaution. Jacob's Ladder and the final forest section are difficult after rain.
impact: Rain has made Jacob's Ladder particularly challenging. Deep mud near Haritha Kanda can make shoes sink. Overgrowth and leeches make the final forest section difficult.
action: Hike with extra caution during rain. Allow extra time for Jacob's Ladder and the final forest section.

title: Stage 7 precaution. Slippery mud near the reservoir and Leopard Corridor.
impact: Slippery, muddy conditions are reported near the reservoir and in the final section near the Leopard Corridor. The section near Kikiliyamana Mountain remains challenging. No overgrowth is reported.
action: Hike with caution during rain, and take extra care on the Kikiliyamana Mountain section.

title: Stage 4 precaution. Two landslide areas, overgrowth and leeches.
impact: Continuous rain has fallen over the last week. Two landslide areas have been identified on the trail. Rapid overgrowth is reported near the abandoned tea factory and after the tunnel. Leeches are active in parts of the stage.
action: Recommended for experienced, knowledgeable hikers only. Take care in the landslide areas and where leeches are active. Do not cross the landslide areas when the ground is wet and muddy.

title: Stage 3 precaution. Two landslide areas and overgrowth on the trail.
impact: Continuous rain has fallen over the last week. Two landslide areas have been identified on the trail. Rapid overgrowth is reported near Stirlingburg Mountain Pass and close to the fine forest section.
action: Hike with caution, especially in wet and muddy conditions. Do not cross the landslide areas during heavy rain or when the ground is wet and muddy.

title: Stage 2 closed due to landslide risk and overgrowth. Do not enter.
impact: Heavy rainfall has caused soil erosion and raised the risk of landslides and obstructions along the route. Rapid overgrowth is making the path hard to pass and to follow.
action: Do not enter Stage 2. The stage stays closed until the route is safe again.

title: Overgrowth and leeches towards Hali Ela
impact: Overgrowth and leeches are reported in the final section towards Hali Ela. Afternoon rain and low visibility can make navigation difficult in overgrown areas.
action: Hike with caution during the rainy season.

title: Overgrowth and leeches after Haputale
impact: The forest section after Haputale is overgrown with many leeches, and a section midway has some overgrowth. Mobile reception may be weak.
action: Take care in rain and early mornings due to low visibility.

title: Uneven surfaces, no mobile reception
impact: Conditions are good, though uneven surfaces make some sections challenging. There is no mobile reception.
action: Hike with caution in rain due to low visibility.

title: Short overgrown section before railway line
impact: After the first 3 km, before the railway line, rain has bent vegetation into the path, making a section of under 50 meters hard to navigate.
action: Hike with caution during the rainy season.

title: Stream crossing and slippery mud
impact: The small stream crossing can be challenging in the rainy season, and the hard mud near the reservoir can be slippery.
action: Hike with caution.

title: Overgrowth near viewpoint
impact: Overgrowth is reported near the viewpoint, and the final pine forest section is slippery.
action: Hike with caution during rain.

title: Muddy and slippery after rain
impact: Afternoon rainfall is making surfaces muddy and slippery, and vegetation growth may narrow some sections.
action: Hikeable with caution in suitable weather.

title: Muddy and slippery – narrowed sections
impact: Afternoon rainfall is making surfaces muddy and slippery, and vegetation growth is narrowing some sections.
action: Hike with extra caution and only in suitable weather.

title: Overgrowth and leeches towards Ettampitiya
impact: Afternoon rain and low visibility can make navigation difficult, especially in overgrown areas.
action: Hike with extra caution during the rainy season.

title: Difficult conditions – Jacob’s Ladder and forest section
impact: Rainfall has made Jacob’s Ladder particularly challenging, and deep mud near Haritha Kanda can cause shoes to sink.
action: Hike with extra caution during rain.

title: Slippery and muddy sections
impact: The section near Kikiliyamana Mountain remains challenging.
action: Hike with caution during rain.

title: Landslide warning – slippery and overgrown
impact: Reduced visibility may affect navigation, and overgrown sections make hiking risky.
action: Please postpone your hike until conditions improve.

title: Landslide warning – continuous rainfall
impact: Low visibility, navigation difficulties, overgrown sections and possible wild-animal encounters make hiking risky.
action: Take extra care, or consider postponing your hike until conditions improve.

title: Rainfall damage and overgrowth
impact: Heavy rainfall has caused soil erosion, landslides and obstructions along the route, and rapid overgrowth is making the path hard to follow.
action: Please do not enter this stage.

title: Heavy rainfall damage. Do not enter
impact: Recent heavy rainfall has caused soil erosion, landslides and several obstructions along the route. Stage 2B: Alternative route will be introduced soon.
action: Please do not enter or attempt this stage.

title: Heavy rainfall damage. Do not enter
impact:
Stage is temporarily closed. Recent heavy rainfall has caused soil erosion, landslides and several obstructions along the route.

Stage 2B: Alternative route will be introduced soon.
action: Please do not enter or attempt this stage.

impact: Stage is open with significant caution. Continuous rainfall is raising the risk of landslides. Low visibility, overgrown sections and possible wild-animal encounters make hiking risky.
action: Take extra care, or consider postponing your hike until conditions improve.
